description: Female, velvety, playful (Audar's own words for it).
referenceText_en: Okay, lean in for just a moment — [whispers] I found the most perfect little café downtown, [mischievously] and it is going to be our new secret spot.
referenceText_ar: حسناً، اقتربي قليلاً — [whispers] وجدتُ مقهىً صغيراً رائعاً في وسط المدينة، [mischievously] وسيكون مكاننا السريّ الجديد!
source: Audar-TTS-V1-Turbo voice gallery (weights/samples/demo_female_2_*.wav), synthetic voice, free to use (weights/README.md, "Voice Gallery"). source.wav is the gallery's reference voice; its words are not published, so it is for listening only.
